issues.basis: NL2 text; exact_source_inventory tr_0008 event='Arrived/Stop, Send Arrived'; inspection_equivalent_facts transition:line:36 triggers=[] guard='R45RouteToken == 8'; FCSTM text lines 24-26 (internal) and line 36 (external)
issues.expected: The InMotion-to-Stopping transition is triggered by the Arrived/Stop, Send Arrived event as established by the source and NL.
issues.observed: The FCSTM transition:line:36 (InMotion->Stopping) has triggers=[] and guard='R45RouteToken == 8'. The event trigger was relocated to internal substate-to-local-exit transitions (lines 24-26) that set the route token; the external transition uses only a guard to select the target.
issues.reason: The source tr_0008 places event 'Arrived/Stop, Send Arrived' directly on the InMotion->Stopping transition. The FCSTM split this into internal triggered transitions (substates->[*]) and an external guarded transition (InMotion->Stopping). The external transition that the NL and source identify as the InMotion->Stopping edge has no trigger.
issues.requirement_quote: the system can either transition to the Stopping state when it arrives, indicated by the "Arrived/Stop, Send Arrived" signal
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The compiler's route-token mechanism preserves the behavioral connection: the internal transitions fire on the event, set the token, and the external transition fires when the token matches. issues.title: Missing Arrived trigger on InMotion-to-Stopping external transition
